title: Monthly planning and closeout cycle
lead: The main rhythm of site work: daily fact-tracking, weekly schedule review, planning by the 25th, submission by the 5th, PTD review by the 10th - payment follows.

steps.what: Submits to PTD the work plan (Б1) + schedule (Б2) + material needs (В1)
steps.ifnot: The month is not funded, materials are not ordered

steps.what: Reconciles the plan with the project, cost estimate and cumulative works register; forwards the requirement to Procurement
Submits the reporting package (Б3): certificate with 2 signatures + timesheets В5 + as-built documentation + delivery notes
steps.ifnot: One missing document - the package is not accepted

steps.what: Reviews the package, reconciles it with the cumulative works register, forwards the technical verification note to the Head of Client's Service
steps.ifnot: Without the note, payment for the month is not confirmed

steps.what: Head of CS approves the certificates, Finance processes payment within limits

daily: By 8:30 - daily headcount to the Telegram chat with Head of CS (by crew)
During the day - 3-5 photos of key zones to the same chat
Site foreman fills in the works log; the driver - the machinery timesheet (В5)
weekly: By 17:00 Friday - schedule plan-fact: "On track" or a written explanation from the PM
By 17:00 - weekly photo report (every work item of the week photographed)
By 18:00 - weekly machinery timesheets to PTD + delivery notes and certificates

errors: Plan not submitted by the 25th - the month is not funded
Incomplete package or missing signature - payment is not considered
Overrun without explanation - the line item is not paid (Г9, Г8)
Work performed to an outdated drawing revision - rework at the fault party's expense

title: Payment path: 8 steps from initiation to payment
lead: No hryvnia moves without documentary confirmation. PTD is the filter that catches overruns BEFORE the money leaves.
warn: There is no such thing as a payment outside the register.

steps.what: Checks prerequisites: contract in the register, cost estimate approved, works accepted
steps.ifnot: Initiation is not possible - close the prerequisite first

steps.what: Enters the payment into the payment register + assembles the full package per payment type (Section 4.2)
steps.ifnot: There is no such thing as a payment outside the register

steps.what: Reconciles with the cost estimate and cumulative works register, checks completeness and signatures
steps.ifnot: Returned to the initiator; resubmit after correction

steps.what: Monthly filter: technical verification note for the month (for the reporting month's certificates)
steps.ifnot: Payment for the month is not confirmed

steps.what: Confirms prices and quantities, records deviations
steps.ifnot: Deviation without explanation - the line item is blocked

steps.what: Approves within limits: up to the limit - Head of CS; above the limit / outside the estimate / advance above the norm - CEO (+Г1)
steps.ifnot: Rejected - reason recorded in the register, returned to the initiator

steps.what: Processes payment per the register; in case of shortfall - per the Head of CS's weekly priority
steps.ifnot: Delay - escalation; status inquiries - via Head of CS, 2 days

steps.what: Updates the register, weekly report to Head of CS: paid / in queue / returned

stops: No contract in the contract register
No Technical Supervision signature on the certificate
No technical verification note for the month
Works performed in suspended zones (Certificate Г4 in effect)
Works performed without Change Request Г1 - unauthorized
A claim with withholding is in effect against the contractor (Г8)
errors: Payment bypassing the register - personal responsibility of the initiator and the performer
Signing a certificate for work not performed - withholding, dismissal on repeat
3+ package returns per month - reviewed at the meeting

title: Overdue escalation
lead: A request without a response within the standard timeframe escalates automatically - no one needs to be "reminded personally".
warn: A report not submitted on time is considered not submitted.

steps.what: Automatic reminder to the responsible person
Escalation to the department head of the person in default
Escalation to Head of CS; the issue is raised at the weekly meeting; recorded via memo (Г9)
Escalation to CEO

errors: A risk outside the register is not accepted as justification for a failure
A problem not reported in the daily summary is not accepted as a reason for falling behind

title: Concealed works and laboratory control
lead: Works to be covered by subsequent works are presented to Technical Supervision BEFORE they are covered. Without the lab technician's protocol and photo documentation, the Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate is not accepted.
warn: Covered without authorization - uncovering at the fault party's expense is possible.

steps.what: Calls Technical Supervision via Worksection BEFORE the works are covered by subsequent works
Takes samples at EVERY concrete pour; testing at 3/7/28 days (Г7)
steps.ifnot: Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate is not closed without the protocol

steps.what: Photo documentation per checklist Д4 + original material certificates
steps.ifnot: Without photos and certificates the Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate is not accepted

steps.what: Inspects the works, signs the Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate (Г2) and as-built diagrams, or issues a Supervision Directive (Г3)
steps.ifnot: Works with a defect note are not closed until the defect is corrected

steps.what: Forwards closed Concealed Works Acceptance Certificates with the package to PTD for the as-built documentation
steps.ifnot: The month's reporting package will not be accepted

errors: The structure has not reached the required strength per the protocol - not accepted: reinforcement or demolition only via Г1
Strength shortfall - the lab technician reports IMMEDIATELY, without waiting for 28 days

title: Project start package
lead: Before any works begin, a complete start package of 13 items must be assembled. This is a gate: without the package, the project is not handed over for execution.
warn: Works started without the package are considered unauthorized - payment is not guaranteed.

steps.what: Project passport: goal, budget, timeline, KPIs, areas of responsibility, risks
Urban planning conditions, utility connection specs, design documentation (site plan, architectural and structural sections), expert review
Permit to carry out construction works
Approved cost estimate: local + facility-level + summary calculation
Works Schedule, funding schedule, contractor portfolio (tender, 3 proposals)
Labor safety + orders appointing the PM and project team

errors: Gate: without the complete start package, the project is not handed over for execution
